detectors.name: Unusually fast high-severity closures
detectors.method: Leave-one-entity-out conformal p-value per case vs peer cases of the same severity and alert type; entity count tested with a beta-binomial peer model
regulations: SEBI CSCRF - SOC functional efficacy: Detective Effectiveness

detectors.name: 24x7 claim vs night-time reality
detectors.method: Share of night-opened (00-06h) high/critical cases acknowledged after > 60 min, for entities that declare 24x7 monitoring
regulations: SEBI CSCRF - 'Whether monitoring through SOC is done round-the-clock?'

detectors.name: Regulatory reporting beyond 6 hours
detectors.method: Share of high/critical true positives with no CERT-In report or a report > 6 h after the first alert
regulations: CERT-In Directions 2022 - report incidents within 6 hours
CEA 2024 - reporting to CERT-In / NCIIPC / CSIRT-Power

log_sources.edr: EDR (process creation, module load, file events)
